valueNote: The page sets out the UAB-to-Michigan timeline with primary-style NBA.com and NBC figures, separates the reporter's injury report from any team statement, and states the conflicting nationality reports from both sources without choosing one. The body claims are backed; the prose is plain and free of hype words and em dashes.
summary: All 11 sources were fetched and every factual claim in the body, summary, knownFor, FAQ answers and person.json facts is supported by the cited source. No claim is wrong, unsupported, outdated or uncited. Quote checks used WebFetch's summarised text, so exact wording was verified against that output, not the raw HTML. Editor-approved exceptions (the {age} placeholder and the removed nationality fact) were not flagged. The page stays in review status for the editor.
